metadata.description: End-to-end open-stack scientific research skills: citation graph lineage, stance/retraction auditing, LaTeX/full-text evidence matrices, anti-patchwork scholarly writing & ABT narrative architecture, and publication-grade data visualization.

plugins.name: research-literature
plugins.description: Open-stack scholarly literature intelligence: seed-to-lineage mapping (ResearchRabbit/Litmaps), interactive HTML citation maps, verbatim citation context & retraction auditing (Scite + Crossref Retraction Watch + arXiv LaTeX \cite{} parser), iterative deep recall & parallel evidence matrices (Undermind + Elicit), and zero-hallucination .bib & OpenReview verification.

plugins.name: scientific-writing
plugins.description: Scholarly writing, scientific storytelling & publication figure suite: Anti-Patchwork Holistic Reconstruction, Olson ABT/Narrative Spectrum & Dobzhansky theme tools, Author Rebuttals & Research Talks, Schimel OCAR/Funnel/SUCCES, Gopen & Swan reader-expectation mechanics, and Wilke + Rougier publication figure & Booktabs table engineering.
